fact: The article states that Moroccan cities lack addressing (the absence of street naming and building numbering), based on interviews with postal workers and bailiffs, and describes the legal and practical situation of addressing in Morocco.
title: Effets de l'adressage sur les activités des facteurs postaux et des huissiers au Maroc
publisher: Revue Internationale du Marketing et Management Stratégique (RIMMS), vol. 8 no. 1
